title: A page-item write runs the past-ruling check before the item posts
why: Page item 475 asked the owner a question his Nov 9 pick already answered; no check runs on a page-item write, so it reached the page.
note: Incident (02:37-02:52 CST Nov 10): the coordinator sent triage a question about the merge tool's read flags; triage posted it as page item 475; the owner's Nov 9 13:09 CST pick (lane-lint-runs-comment-check) already answered it; the Stop hook's past-ruling check caught it in the coordinator's report, after the item posted. Fix: the ArtifactData write of a new open item runs the same past-ruling check the Stop hook uses (rule past-ruling) and refuses an item a past ruling answers. Related: past-ruling-on-send (ready; judges the send to the page writer).
